ai_summary: Aaron Industries Limited has fixed Friday, August 14, 2026, as the Record Date for its recommended Final Dividend of ₹0.50 per equity share for the Financial Year 2025-26. This dividend is subject to shareholder approval at the Annual General Meeting on August 19, 2026, with eligible shareholders on record by the specified date receiving payment within 30 days post-AGM. This is a routine regulatory disclosure regarding dividend distribution with no apparent red flags.
